properties.name: resilience4cata.defaults.retry.enabled
properties.description: Default enabled of every retry (true or false).

properties.name: resilience4cata.defaults.retry.max-attempts
properties.description: Default maxAttempts of every retry (an integer).

properties.name: resilience4cata.defaults.retry.delay
properties.description: Default delay of every retry (a duration such as 250ms, 2s or PT2S).

properties.name: resilience4cata.defaults.retry.backoff
properties.description: Default backoff of every retry (one of the listed values).

properties.name: resilience4cata.defaults.retry.multiplier
properties.description: Default multiplier of every retry (a number).

properties.name: resilience4cata.instances
properties.description: Per-instance overrides: instances.<id>.<policy>.<attribute>, applied over the annotation. Put an id other than letters, digits, _ and - in brackets: instances[com.acme.Api#get(java.lang.String)].timeout.value.

properties.name: resilience4cata.profiles.active
properties.description: resilience4cata profiles to apply (profiles.<name>.* keys), later ones winning.
